title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
Activities

To simulate rate steps, access billing in the simulation mode or perform periodic billing with integrated budget billing simulation.
You access the transaction for individual billing simulation in the SAP menu under |}Utilities Industry » Billing » Billing Execution
Individual Processing » Individual Simulation » Billing

i Note

To ensure simulation is as accurate as possible, note the following:

e Inthe time-of-use interface, use a consumption pattern (and a synthetic profile) that best suits the customer
consumption situation.

e Enter the period consumption for interval meters during move-in.
e Enter a percentage minimum share that is as large as possible in the rate.

e If you create a contract in a vacant status period, for example, with the owner of a rented apartment, we recommend
that you implement BAdI ISU_LFASTEDM_TOU_SIMULATION, method DETERMINE_CONTRACTS.

More Information

For more information about the simulation process flow, see the system documentation TOU Simulation, which you can access
from a link in the description of the field Consumption Pattern (F1 Help) in the time-of-use interface.

Business Function Utilities, Advanced Metering Infrastructure 4 (ISU AMI_4)

Technical Reference

This section describes the technical requirements for contract billing based on profile values in an MDUS system:

e Business Function:

The business function Advanced Metering Infrastructure 2 (ISU _AMI_ 2) is active.

e Enterprise Services for MDUS Request:

o UtilitiesTimeSeriesCalculationERPBulkCreateRequest Out transfers the request items to the
MDUS system.

o UtilitiesTimeSeriesCalculationERPBulkCreateConfirmation In sends the results of the request
items back to the SAP system.

o UtilitiesTimeSeriesCalculationERPCancellationBulkRequest_ Out repeats the MDUS request.
That is, it reverses an existing request and sends a new one.

e Business Add-Ins (BAdlIs):
o ISU _MDUS_ FORMULA enables additional consistency checks for the time-of-use formula.

o ISU MDUS_IFACE enables additional consistency checks for the time-of-use interface.
